sv.title: Centralbankstopp: Sluta fippla med mandatet
sv.summary: Paul Conway, chefekonom vid Nya Zeelands centralbank RBNZ, uppmanar framtida finansministrar att sluta mixtra med centralbankens mandat. Det rapporterar Bloomberg News.

en.title: Central bank stop: Stop tinkering with the mandate
en.summary: Paul Conway, chief economist at New Zealand's central bank RBNZ, urges future finance ministers to stop meddling with the central bank's mandate. Bloomberg News reports.
